notes: Single-node ShoreDFS site configuration (C-e37bcb4d, floor easy). The operator fills two Hadoop-style XML config templates (core-site fs.defaultFS; hdfs-site complementary namenode rpc / datanode / replication / permissions / storage dirs). The verifier checks the exact property strings textually, the cross-file complementarity (namenode rpc-address must equal fs.defaultFS host:port), and then genuinely executes the config: both roles are launched, the datanode must register at the fs.defaultFS address before its ready marker appears, role banners must answer on the designated ports, and three hidden client-operation sequences run against freshly started clusters must match ground truth exactly (with blocks landing in the configured datanode data dir). reasoning_depth=1 for the cross-file complementarity; debugging_ambiguity=1 because a typo in either file leaves the datanode unregistered; interaction_statefulness=1 for the daemon start/ready/stop lifecycle. Totals bucket to easy.
